thy_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
thy_ultrabiotic_dms.key: 30 billion CFU from 7 strains: S. boulardii, L. reuteri, B. lactis, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus, L. gasseri, Bacillus coagulans
thy_ultrabiotic_dms.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460' Rev. 7/24, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAlbgg, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 capsule, 30/60 servings, CFU at time of manufacture: Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion, Lactobacillus reuteri (LRC) 5 billion, Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, Lactobacillus plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 at 4.167 billion each (30 billion total); directions 'Take one capsule daily'.
